[[Vanyi]] sends you back to the [[Crystal Desert]] to learn new lessons — and new [[profession]]s — from the [[ghost]]s there.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Prophecies
| completed = Augury Rock
}}

===Objectives===
* Travel to [[Seeker's Passage]].
* Travel to [[Destiny's Gorge]].
* Travel to [[Heroes' Audience]].
* Return to Vanyi for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
[[Map travel]] back to each of the three outposts in the [[Crystal Desert]], or run to them from [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]] if necessary. Once all three have been visited, return to [[Droknar's Forge]] and claim the reward from [[Vanyi]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Vanyi
:''"Come closer, <character name>. Look me in the eye... As I thought! You've got the look of someone who's been to Augury Rock and come out the other side. A true hero in the making.''

:''Well, listen to me, hero: do not be deceived. The desert still holds more secrets for you to unlock. Take my advice and seek out the places called '''Seeker's Passage''' and '''Destiny's Gorge''' and '''Heroes' Audience'''.. There you may find challenges worthy of a true champion."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Thank you for the advice.
| decline = Leave me alone!
| ask = Further challenges await you in the desert. You search for the places called '''Seeker's Passage''' and '''Destiny's Gorge''' and '''Heroes' Audience'''.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Vanyi
:''"You traveled all that way and didn't bother talking to a single one of the ghosts there, did you? No no no no... Don't bother denying it. I'd know if you had. I've an eye for these things. Well, at any rate now you know where they are. Next time, try talking to the ghosts. You may find they have interesting things to say."''

==Notes==
*The quest is intended to lead players to the new quests available in the three listed outposts, which unlock the ability to change your secondary profession. Completing those quests is not required to claim the reward for this quest, but will unlock Vanyi's [[attribute point]] quest, [[The Hero's Challenge]].
**If a character has already visited the outposts and changed professions before talking to Vanyi, it is possible to acquire both quests at the same time.
*Having visited those locations previously will not fulfill the objectives, but allows you to do so by simple map travel.
*The reward dialogue is the same even if you have completed one of the profession quests and learned how to change your secondary profession.
